request: Bounded HyVibe adapter provenance/terms audit, standards comparison, plan updates and unsent outreach draft.

scope.review: Headers, selected implementations, wire values, fixtures, manifests, prior findings and hardware receipts. No original vendor-source comparison.

prior_apk_report.status: Historical founding-plan report only; original artifact/full digest/trusted signing identity not re-established in this audit.
search_scope: Ringdown port including hidden/non-ignored files, excluding target/.git
Known prior repos/ringdown and crates/ringdown locations
Top-level /tmp and Downloads names containing HyVibe or Ringdown
not_reproduced: Packaged resource phrase searches and registration terms display
Runtime-delivered terms and store/account acceptance history

artifact_scan.apk_dex_java_smali_or_firmware_bundle_in: No matching research/code artifact filenames found in scoped non-target inventory; not a forensic binary-content scan.
artifact_scan.vendor_sdk_dependency: No named vendor SDK in the inspected manifests or resolved package metadata.
artifact_scan.metadata_caveat: No missing declarations or GPL declarations in 124 packages. Full license text, notices, native/system libraries, platform SDKs and release feature/target variants are outside this metadata check.

open_frontier: A1: Establish authoritative app acquisition, full digest/signing identity, version-specific presented/remote/store terms and acceptance evidence.
A2: Review codec/dictionary necessity and implementation provenance; separate functional facts from protectable expression.
A3: Resolve PacketLogger GPL-format-reference derivation and notices before shipping diagnostic app.
A4: Confirm MIDI/BLE specification access/IP/logo terms and OS-only application Bluetooth qualification scope; no assumed fee or exemption.
A5: Verify actual standards-only artifact excludes vendor RPC/codec/PacketLogger; maintain generic audio/SMF paths.
A6: Review public fixtures for device identifiers and preset/content rights; use original/synthetic assets.

A7: Obtain vendor clarification/appropriate written grant for HyVibe-specific implementation and public docs with downstream open-source/commercial redistribution; legal review in publisher/distribution jurisdictions.
outcome: Assessment complete with scoped evidence and explicit unresolved release questions; no non-infringement or legal-clearance verdict.
limitations: No complete source-to-Android expression comparison; original APK/decompiled tree was not located.
No new APK acquisition, decompilation, vendor/server login, store acceptance reconstruction or guitar probe.
No exhaustive Git-history/credential/content scan, patent freedom-to-operate opinion, legal jurisdiction determination or release approval.
Package metadata declarations only; no blanket audit of license texts/notices, operating-system/system-library rights, SDKs or every release feature/target.
Public source text and current source inventory were inspected; no gated MIDI standard PDF was downloaded.
preparation_notes: An initial relative audit-output mkdir was made from /tmp; the metadata redirection failed before Cargo ran. Absolute output paths were used for the successful run.
